name: CyberAlchemy Controlled Technical English Trial Profile
relationship_to_standard: Separately authored local trial constraints informed by publicly described ASD-STE100 objectives and safeguards; not a reproduction or complete implementation of the standard.
scope: Descriptive and procedural English for bounded CyberAlchemy technical documentation trials.
excluded_claims: ASD certification, authorization, approval, or endorsement
replacement of trained technical writers or reviewers

local_constraints.statement: Use no more than 20 words in a procedural sentence.
Use no more than 25 words in a descriptive sentence.
Use one main topic in each sentence.
Use the same term for the same concept in one bounded context.
Do not use semicolons or contractions.
Put a required condition before the action that depends on it.

term_policy.dictionary_boundary: The ASD-STE100 dictionary is not bundled, copied, or treated as checked by this profile.

review_policy.human_owner: the named technical-documentation owner or qualified reviewer
review_policy.confidentiality_rule: Do not send protected technical content to an external model without an authorized data-handling boundary.
